component.name: MeshBench
component.summary: Plan and test MeshCore LoRa networks against real firmware

description.p: MeshBench runs real MeshCore firmware against a sample-accurate LoRa channel over real terrain, so the question it answers is not whether a packet might get through but what actually arrived at the antenna, and why.

Place nodes on a map, run the network, and read what happened: every transmission and reception, why a packet was lost, the terrain profile between two sites, and the link budget with the assumptions stated. The firmware under test is the firmware that ships on the hardware.
Results are a best case - no multipath, bare earth, an ideal demodulator - and the application says so wherever it shows a number.
